headline: Nevish Line Clashes Intensify as Callahan's Passage Front Reignites
war_summary: Nevish Line remains the war's most violent theater, where ten fresh base transactions over the past two hours settled into three Warden bastions against five Colonial strongholds amidst more than thirty-four hundred combined casualties. Violent action also reignited in Callahan's Passage, where a fierce flare-up at Crumbling Post brought two base changes and over twenty-five hundred casualties in two hours, with casualty rates sharply accelerating. In Linn of Mercy, persistent contesting across Rotdust and Outwich Ranch yielded four further transactions and more than three thousand dead, keeping the sector locked in turmoil. Conversely, direct base turnover ceased across the Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf, where frontlines quieted following earlier exchanges. Heavy slaughter without territorial shift continues to grip Mooring County and Clahstra, where casualty figures spiked dramatically over the past two hours despite stationary frontlines.
